<title level="1" right="Necromancer Fatal Method " pfs="Standard">[Puppeteer](/FatalMethods.aspx?ID=1)</title>

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 29

You prefer to study life and death from afar. You gain the Consume Thrall action and the thrall proliferation ability.

<row gap="tiny">
**Consume Thrall**
<actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [necromancer](/Traits.aspx?ID=950), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) **Frequency** once per day; **Requirements** You have 0 Focus Points and at least one thrall with 30 feet of you; **Effects** You destroy one thrall within 30 feet of you and regain 1 Focus Point. You can spend this focus point only to cast a grave spell.
</row>

**Thrall Proliferation**
Once per round when you cast [_create thrall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2895), you can create one additional thrall in range.

fields.markdown:
<title level="1" right="Necromancer Fatal Method " pfs="Standard">[Reaper](/FatalMethods.aspx?ID=2)</title>

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 29

You study flesh up close by clashing blade against bone. You gain the reaper’s edge and thrall teamwork abilities.

<row gap="tiny">
**Reaper’s Edge**
You become trained in martial weapons and medium armor. At 11th level, you become an expert in martial weapons, and at 13th you become an expert in medium armor.
</row>

**Thrall Teamwork**
Once per round after you cast [_create thrall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2895), you can make a melee Strike as a free action against a creature within your melee reach that is adjacent to at least one of your thralls.
